# Seller scope, temp mdr_sale_cur_type: removes one ship of that type (it goes into the refit yard).
mdr_sale_take_one = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_sale_cur_type = 1 } } destroy_ships = { type = carrier count = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_sale_cur_type = 2 } } destroy_ships = { type = helicopter_operator count = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_sale_cur_type = 3 } } destroy_ships = { type = battleship count = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_sale_cur_type = 4 } } destroy_ships = { type = battle_cruiser count = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_sale_cur_type = 5 } } destroy_ships = { type = cruiser count = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_sale_cur_type = 6 } } destroy_ships = { type = stealth_destroyer count = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_sale_cur_type = 7 } } destroy_ships = { type = destroyer count = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_sale_cur_type = 8 } } destroy_ships = { type = screen_destroyer count = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_sale_cur_type = 9 } } destroy_ships = { type = stealth_frigate count = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_sale_cur_type = 10 } } destroy_ships = { type = frigate count = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_sale_cur_type = 11 } } destroy_ships = { type = heavy_frigate count = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_sale_cur_type = 12 } } destroy_ships = { type = corvette count = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_sale_cur_type = 13 } } destroy_ships = { type = stealth_corvette count = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_sale_cur_type = 14 } } destroy_ships = { type = patrol_boat count = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_sale_cur_type = 15 } } destroy_ships = { type = missile_submarine count = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_sale_cur_type = 16 } } destroy_ships = { type = attack_submarine count = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_sale_cur_type = 17 } } destroy_ships = { type = repair_ship count = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_sale_cur_type = 18 } } destroy_ships = { type = support_ship count = 1 } }
}

	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_sale_type = 7 } } set_variable = { mdr_sale_gen_max = 7 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_sale_type = 9 } } set_variable = { mdr_sale_gen_max = 5 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_sale_type = 10 } } set_variable = { mdr_sale_gen_max = 8 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_sale_type = 12 } } set_variable = { mdr_sale_gen_max = 8 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_sale_type = 13 } } set_variable = { mdr_sale_gen_max = 5 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_sale_type = 14 } } set_variable = { mdr_sale_gen_max = 5 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_sale_type = 15 } } set_variable = { mdr_sale_gen_max = 8 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_sale_type = 16 } } set_variable = { mdr_sale_gen_max = 8 } }
}

# Steps to the next or previous hull the seller really has, through 0 (any hull). Input temp mdr_sale_dir, 1 or -1.
mdr_sale_gen_step = {
	mdr_sale_read_gen_max = yes
	set_temp_variable = { mdr_sale_go = 1 }
	set_temp_variable = { mdr_sale_guard = 0 }
	while_loop_effect = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mdr_sale_go = 1 } check_variable = { mdr_sale_guard < 30 } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { mdr_sale_guard = 1 }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_sale_gen = mdr_sale_dir }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_sale_gen > mdr_sale_gen_max } } set_variable = { mdr_sale_gen = 0 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_sale_gen < 0 } } set_variable = { mdr_sale_gen = mdr_sale_gen_max } }
		mdr_sale_check_gen = yes
		if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { mdr_sale_gen = 0 } check_variable = { mdr_sale_gen_ok = 1 } } } set_temp_variable = { mdr_sale_go = 0 } }
	}
}

# Steps to the next or previous hull the seller has researched. Input temp mdr_sale_dir, 1 or -1.
mdr_sd_hull_step = {
	set_temp_variable = { mdr_sale_go = 1 }
	set_temp_variable = { mdr_sale_guard = 0 }
	while_loop_effect = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mdr_sale_go = 1 } check_variable = { mdr_sale_guard < 90 } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { mdr_sale_guard = 1 }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_sd_hull = mdr_sale_dir }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_sd_hull > 89 } } set_variable = { mdr_sd_hull = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_sd_hull < 1 } } set_variable = { mdr_sd_hull = 89 } }
		mdr_sd_read_hull = yes
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_sd_ok = 1 } } set_temp_variable = { mdr_sale_go = 0 } }
	}
}

# Seller scope (ROOT), global.mdr_sale_to the buyer. Input temps mdr_sale_cur_hull, mdr_sale_cur_design.
# Ready-made designs are created in the seller the first time (obsolete, so they stay out of its production list,
# as the base game does in _generic_decisions.txt). "Export N" is the seller's own design; if there is none, the hull's basic one.
mdr_sd_deliver = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_sale_cur_hull = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_sale_cur_design = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = mdr_sdv_1_1 } }
				create_equipment_variant = { name = "Export CV-1965 MP" type = carrier_hull_1 parent_version = 0 obsolete = yes modules = { front_1_custom_slot = module_naval_anti_torpedo_1 front_2_custom_slot = module_naval_anti_torpedo_1 mid_1_custom_slot = module_helipads_1 mid_2_custom_slot = module_helipads_1 mid_3_custom_slot = module_naval_adl_1 rear_1_custom_slot = module_naval_adl_1 rear_2_custom_slot = module_fuel_tank fixed_ship_flight_deck = module_flight_deck_6 fixed_ship_auxillary_slot = module_naval_asw_nuclear_torpedoes_1 fixed_ship_auxillary_slot_1 = module_naval_asw_nuclear_torpedoes_1 fixed_ship_auxillary_slot_2 = module_anti_ship_drone_torpedoes_1 fixed_ship_radar_slot = module_radar_1 fixed_ship_fire_control_system_slot = module_analog_fire_control fixed_ship_engine_slot = module_surface_early_reactor_power } }
